about: An extensive math library for JavaScript and Node.js.

prs.title: Standard deviation and variance count dimensions the same way
prs.broken: In the expression parser, standard deviation and variance with a chosen method counted dimensions from zero, while the short form counted from one. The same dimension gave different answers.
prs.changed: The parser now converts the last number after the data, so both forms count dimensions from one. Other functions give the same results as before.
prs.matters: Statistics typed into the calculator line up across forms instead of quietly using the wrong rows or columns.
